item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":0,"rationale":"The segment only recounts prior presidential action, an international agreement, and the beginning of an authority citation; it performs no current operative act or direction.","evidence":"On December 10, 2008, the United States entered into an agreement with Israel"},{"segment_id":"2","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently makes the statutory necessity determination concerning duty-free access for specified Israeli agricultural products through December 31, 2009; the legal consequence occurs upon that determination, with tariff implementation supplied elsewhere.","evidence":"I have determined that it is necessary"},{"segment_id":"3","code":0,"rationale":"The segment recites prior tariff action, statutory authority, an agreement, and satisfaction of consultation requirements, but contains no current operative presidential action.","evidence":"The consultation and layover requirements of section 103(a) of the USCFTA Act with respect to the accelerated schedule of duty elimination were satisfied as of November 8, 2008."},{"segment_id":"4","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently makes the statutory determination that the later-proclaimed Chilean duty-rate modifications are necessary or appropriate; that determination occurs in this segment even though the tariff modifications occur elsewhere.","evidence":"I have determined that modifications hereinafter proclaimed of rates of duties on originating goods of Chile are necessary or appropriate"},{"segment_id":"5","code":0,"rationale":"The segment consists solely of historical facts and descriptions of statutory authority; it neither presently changes import treatment nor directs an official to do so.","evidence":"Section 604 of the Trade Act of 1974, as amended"},{"segment_id":"6","code":3,"rationale":"The President directly modifies the HTS, fixes the applicability and duration of tariff treatment, provides a condition for Australian rules-of-origin changes to take effect, and supersedes inconsistent prior provisions; these legal consequences arise by the proclamation itself on the stated dates or condition.","evidence":"the HTS is modified as provided in Annex I to this proclamation"}]}
